annealing_provenance.scientific_rationale: Unannealed devices (as_fabricated_unannealed) represent a deliberate physical state (T=20C, duration=0min). They are modeled with an explicit binary flag 'is_annealed = 0', rather than treated as missing data.

carrier_density_provenance.scientific_rationale: Distinguishes directly measured Hall carrier density from electrostatic gating capacitance calculation (n_2D = Cox*(Vgs-Vth)/q). Prevents conflating electrostatic gating with Hall transport measurements.

vacuum_pressure_provenance.scientific_rationale: Differentiates explicit UHV chamber readings (< 1e-8 Torr) from standard high-vacuum base pressure.

schottky_barrier_measurements.scientific_rationale: Measured SBH is strictly separated from physics-estimated SBH to prevent data leakage and circular reasoning in contact resistance prediction.
